aboutGame.title: What is Dragongrove?
paragraphs: Dragongrove is a fantasy sanctuary management and adventure game where you restore a fractured grove and raise mythical dragons. You clear corrupted overgrowth, build elemental habitats, and bond with drakes that each belong to an affinity such as Ember, Verdant, Torrent, Gale, or Umbral.

Progression runs on a day-night cycle of foraging, terraforming, breeding, and expeditions. As your Grove Sanctuary Level rises you unlock dual-element habitats, cross-breeding altars, and high-altitude expedition routes filled with relics, rare seeds, and primal dragon eggs.

modules.name: Dragongrove Beginner Guide
modules.description: New players learn the basic gameplay loop, first-time setup, and early progression path. It covers interacting with dragons, clearing corrupted overgrowth, and building familiarity with the grove.

highlights.detail: Scout the grove and clear mist-covered plots to open your first building space.
Build basic nesting grounds, a feeding trough, and a woodcutter bench.
Hatch or adopt your first companion, then feed and groom it daily.
Assign your drake to a task that matches its elemental affinity.
Set a morning harvest routine for timber, Sunlit Dew, and Emberberry.
Raise your Grove Sanctuary Level to unlock the first elemental roosts.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dragongrove.

items.question: What is Dragongrove?
items.answer: Dragongrove is a fantasy sanctuary management game where you restore a magical grove and raise elemental dragons. You clear corrupted terrain, build habitats, breed new drakes, and send expedition teams into hazardous biomes.

items.question: How do I raise my Grove Sanctuary Level in Dragongrove?
items.answer: Complete restoration milestones, hatch new species, and keep companions happy. Each level unlocks new habitat footprints and structures such as the Nursery and the Alchemical Forge.

items.question: What are the elemental affinities in Dragongrove?
items.answer: Dragons belong to affinities including Ember, Verdant, Torrent, Gale, and Umbral. Matching a dragon to its native biome boosts mood, essence production, and expedition perks.

items.question: How do expeditions work in Dragongrove?
items.answer: You send elemental teams into zones such as Bramblewood Thicket or Frostfall Crevasse. Match party resistances to the biome, pack provisions, and return with relics, runes, and rare eggs.

items.question: Is Dragongrove free to play?
items.answer: Dragongrove is planned as a paid PC release on Steam with an Early Access phase, followed by console ports after launch.

items.question: Where do Dragongrove rewards come from?
items.answer: Rewards come from puzzle shrines, elite sentinels, and boss drop pools. Check the Dragongrove rewards guide for cache tiers, drop rates, and farming routes.
